sections.title: Christmas and New Year at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Some people want Christmas at home. Others would rather hand the cooking to someone else and come down to a cooked breakfast. If that is you, or you need rooms for family coming to Motherwell for the holidays, our festive stays are for you.

The house dates from 1874 and has 18 en-suite bedrooms: singles, twins, doubles and a family room that sleeps up to three, each with a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. Under the same roof are the restaurant, the conservatory and the function suite, where our Christmas Day lunch, party nights, Hogmanay dinner and New Year’s Day lunch take place, so a stay can be as busy or as quiet as you like.

What’s included changes from year to year: we may offer a package with dinner and breakfast, or rooms priced for the holidays with our events booked alongside. Ask what’s included this year and we’ll tell you plainly, and whether breakfast is part of your rate will be clear on your confirmation. Glasgow is about 12 miles away and Edinburgh about 30, so Christmas shopping or Hogmanay celebrations in either city are within reach.
sections.aside_html:
• 18 en-suite rooms: single, twin, double and family (up to 3)
  • Full Scottish breakfast cooked to order, where it is part of your rate
  • Festive events under the same roof, from Christmas Day lunch to Hogmanay
  • Free parking; Motherwell station about 5 minutes’ walk
  • Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am; non-smoking throughout

sections.title: The rooms, the breakfast and what is on under the same roof

items.title: The rooms
items.text: Singles, twins, doubles and a family room for up to three, all en suite, in a house dating from 1874. Some doubles have bay windows.

items.title: Breakfast
items.text: A full Scottish breakfast, cooked to order. Your confirmation shows whether it is included in your rate; if not, ask us about adding it to your stay.

items.title: The events
items.text: Christmas Day lunch, party nights, Hogmanay dinner and New Year's Day lunch all happen under the same roof as your room.

sections.title: Festive stays: what people ask us

items.q: How do I book a festive stay?
items.a: Rooms can be booked online for any dates over the holidays. To ask what is included this year, or to add a table at one of our events, call 01698 265588 or send an enquiry.
Payment and cancellation terms depend on the rate you book and are set out in your confirmation. For a package with meals we may ask for a deposit, and we’ll say so when you book.

items.q: Can we eat at the hotel over Christmas and New Year?
items.a: Yes. We hold a Christmas Day lunch, Hogmanay dinner and New Year’s Day lunch, and party nights through December. The restaurant’s own opening over the holidays is confirmed each season; tell us which meals you’d like when you book.

items.q: Is there parking, and do trains run over the holidays?
items.a: Parking is free for the length of your stay. Train services are very limited on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year’s Day, so check times before you travel. By road, the M74 (junction 6) is close by.

sections.title: Spend the holidays with us
sections.text: Check availability for your dates, or ask us what’s included in this year’s festive stays.
